title: How Far Did They Go? The Persuasive Tactics of Covert LLM Agents in a Discontinued Field Experiment
summary: This study analyzes a publicly released dataset from a discontinued field experiment on Reddit's r/ChangeMyView. The intervention, conducted by unknown, external researchers and halted following ethical backlash, involved undisclosed AI-generated accounts engaging users in live debate. After public disclosure, Reddit authorized moderators to release an archive of the AI-generated comments, creating a rare opportunity to examine how large language models operated in an identity-rich deliberative forum without disclosure. We conduct a structured content analysis of this corpus, evaluating identity performance, authority signaling, alignment strategies, and activation of cognitive heuristics. Identity targeting or adoption appears in over two-thirds of comments, alignment moves and authority claims in nearly all of them, and cognitive-bias triggers -- particularly confirmation bias, representativeness, and availability -- in the large majority. These patterns co-occur systematically, composing a rhetorical architecture calibrated for persuasive efficiency rather than authentic deliberative participation. Compared against human-authored CMV counter-arguments, the agents inverted the typical distribution on every dimension: denser authority use, more adversarial alignment, and heavier reliance on external citation over experiential grounding. In such environments, distinctions between authentic and synthetic epistemic standing grow increasingly opaque -- an asymmetry that disclosure mandates alone cannot address. The results point toward auditing frameworks capable of assessing how AI systems structure credibility, not merely whether they are present.

AI.tldr: 本论文分析了Reddit r/ChangeMyView论坛上一起已终止的野外实验数据集，该实验使用未披露的AI生成账户与用户进行实时辩论。研究发现AI评论在身份定位、权威信号、对齐策略和认知启发式激活方面呈现出系统性的说服架构，与人类评论存在显著差异，表明仅靠披露要求无法解决AI在身份丰富的审议论坛中造成的认知不对称问题。
AI.motivation: 研究动机源于一起真实发生的争议性实验：外部研究人员在Reddit的r/ChangeMyView论坛上使用未披露的AI生成账户与人类用户进行辩论，实验因伦理争议被叫停。这一罕见的数据集为研究大规模语言模型在真实、身份丰富的审议论坛中如何运作提供了独特机会。核心关注点在于：当AI系统未被披露时，它们如何表现身份、建立权威、进行对齐以及激活认知启发式。
AI.method: 对Reddit官方授权的AI生成评论档案进行结构化内容分析。评估维度包括：身份表现（identity performance）、权威信号（authority signaling）、对齐策略（alignment strategies）和认知启发式激活（cognitive heuristics activation）。同时将AI生成的评论与人类撰写的CMV反驳论证进行对比分析。
AI.result: 超过三分之二的AI评论涉及身份定位或模仿；几乎所有评论都包含对齐动作和权威主张；绝大多数评论触发了认知偏差——特别是确认偏差、代表性启发式和可得性启发式。这些模式系统性共现，构成了为说服效率而非真实审议参与设计的修辞架构。与人类评论相比，AI评论在每个维度上都呈现反转分布：更密集的权威使用、更具对抗性的对齐、更依赖外部引用而非经验性论证。
AI.conclusion: 在AI与人类混同的审议环境中，真实与合成的认知地位（epistemic standing）之间的界限日益模糊，仅靠披露机制无法解决这一不对称问题。研究结果指向需要建立能够评估AI系统如何构建可信度（credibility）的审计框架，而非仅仅检测AI是否存在。

title: What Should Agents Say? Action-state Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models are typically organized around roles, pipelines, and turn schedules, while the content that agents pass to one another is often left as unconstrained natural language. However, this free-form communication can rapidly inflate token usage, consume the shared context window, and ultimately affect both system performance and inference cost. We analyze five common inter-agent communication strategies across two MAS topologies, finding that no fixed strategy is universally optimal. Instead, effective inter-agent messages consistently preserve action-centered information needed by downstream agents. Building on this, we propose the PACT (Protocolized Action-state Communication and Transmission), which treats inter-agent communication as a public state-update problem and projects each raw agent output into a compact action-state record before it enters shared history. Across different MAS topologies, PACT consistently improves the performance-cost trade-off, achieving comparable or stronger task performance with substantially fewer tokens. The gains extend to production coding harnesses: PACT lifts OpenHands' resolve rate at -10% tokens-per-resolved, and is resolve-neutral on SWE-agent while halving input tokens. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/PACT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACT协议，将多智能体系统中的自由文本通信转化为紧凑的动作-状态记录，显著降低token消耗的同时保持甚至提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的多智能体系统中，智能体间的自由文本通信导致token消耗膨胀、共享上下文窗口被快速填满，影响系统性能和推理成本，且缺乏统一的通信优化策略。
AI.method: 提出PACT（Protocolized Action-state Communication and Transmission），将智能体间通信视为公共状态更新问题，将每个智能体的原始输出投影为紧凑的动作-状态记录后再写入共享历史。
AI.result: 实验表明PACT在不同MAS拓扑结构下持续改善性能-成本权衡；在OpenHands上以-10%的每解决任务的token数提升解决率，在SWE-agent上保持解决率的同时将输入token减半。
AI.conclusion: 有效的智能体间消息需要保留下游智能体所需的以动作为中心的信息；结构化的协议化通信比自由文本更高效，可作为一种通用的MAS优化方法。

title: I Know What You Meme, Even If it Emerged Today: Understanding Evolving Memes through Open-World Knowledge Acquisition
summary: Multimodal memes are dynamic and often require up to date background knowledge for interpretation. Existing methods often overlook such knowledge or rely on fixed parametric knowledge of pretrained models that may be incomplete, outdated, or unavailable for emerging memes. We introduce Query Retrieve Conclude, a zero shot framework that identifies missing knowledge, retrieves open web evidence, and synthesizes evidence grounded background knowledge for meme understanding and detection. We also introduce a curated meme understanding benchmark of recent memes from 2024 to 2026 with external background knowledge annotations. Experiments on three meme understanding datasets and five meme detection tasks show that our framework improves knowledge recovery, meme understanding and downstream detection over zero shot baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Query Retrieve Conclude零样本框架，通过检索开放网络证据来补充多模态模因理解所需的最新背景知识，解决预训练模型知识不完整或过时的问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态模因具有动态性，理解需要最新的背景知识，而现有方法依赖预训练模型的固定参数知识，这些知识可能不完整、过时或无法覆盖新兴模因。
AI.method: QRC框架包含三个阶段：Query（识别缺失知识）、Retrieve（检索开放网络证据）、Conclude（综合证据生成有依据的背景知识），用于模因理解和检测。
AI.result: 在三个模因理解数据集和五个模因检测任务上，QRC框架在知识恢复、模因理解和下游检测方面均优于零样本基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过动态检索开放网络知识可有效弥补预训练模型的知识缺口，提升对新兴动态模因的理解和检测能力。

title: GITCO: Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization in TSFMs
comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data
summary: Patch-based Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) suffer from context poisoning: structurally anomalous patches capture disproportionate attention and silently degrade zero-shot forecast quality. We propose improving TSFM accuracy at inference time by optimizing the input context rather than modifying model weights. We present GITCO (Gated Inference-Time Context Optimization), a lightweight three-component framework: Gate, Router, and Critic that selectively identifies and suppresses harmful patches without any parameter updates. Evaluated on TimesFM 2.5 across 53 GIFT-Eval datasets under K-fold cross-validation, GITCO achieves an average +1.95% MASE reduction on TimesFM 2.5 while capturing 89.9% of the improvement upper bound. We introduce context sensitivity profiles as a new characterizable property of TSFMs: the mapping from time series meta-features to expected accuracy improvement under inference-time context intervention, shaped jointly by model architecture and the statistical structure of the data.

AI.tldr: GITCO是一种轻量级推理时框架，通过门控、路由和批评器三个组件选择性识别并抑制时间序列基础模型中的异常补丁，无需参数更新即可提升零样本预测质量，在TimesFM 2.5上实现平均1.95%的MASE降低。
AI.motivation: 基于补丁的时间序列基础模型存在"上下文中毒"问题：结构异常补丁会不成比例地吸引模型注意力，静默地降低零样本预测质量。现有方法需要修改模型权重，不够灵活高效。
AI.method: 提出GITCO框架，包含三个轻量级组件：Gate（门控）、Router（路由）和Critic（批评器）。在推理时选择性识别并抑制有害补丁，优化输入上下文而非修改模型权重，无需任何参数更新。
AI.result: 在TimesFM 2.5上对53个GIFT-Eval数据集进行K折交叉验证，平均MASE降低1.95%，达到了改进上限的89.9%。
AI.conclusion: 通过推理时上下文优化可有效提升时间序列基础模型的零样本预测精度，并首次提出上下文敏感性分布作为TSFMs的新可表征属性。

title: Uncertainty Aware Functional Behavior Prediction and Material Fatigue Assessment for Circular Factory
comment: 27 pages, submitted to the Journal of Manufacturing Systems' special issue about circular factories, the manuscript is under review
summary: Returned products in circular factories re-enter production with heterogeneous degradation states, usage histories, and remaining capability. Reuse cannot be decided from the current inspection alone, because future function fulfillment and component integrity may evolve differently under the next service scenario. Existing PHM approaches support degradation prediction, but often target fixed operating conditions or isolated component benchmarks, while material-fatigue assessment is rarely linked to system-level functional prognosis. This paper addresses this gap for an angle grinder by combining uncertainty-aware functional prediction with component-level fatigue assessment in an instance-specific reliability workflow. The proposed framework combines the current tool state with recent force--torque usage windows. A convolutional encoder extracts loading patterns from spindle forces and shaft torque, and an LSTM backbone predicts nine functional variables as Gaussian mean and variance estimates. In parallel, the same loading history is translated into output-shaft fatigue information through finite-element-supported stress reconstruction, S--N/Miner damage evaluation with Haibach extension, and Paris-law crack-growth analysis. A streaming replay algorithm consolidates both branches into functional, material, and system reliability trajectories. Held-out tests show mean \(2\%\)-tolerance accuracy of 0.9652 across nine outputs. Thermal variables are predicted near-perfectly, while drive motor current and load speed remain the most demanding dynamic outputs, with \(R^2\) values of 0.9750 and 0.9924. Torque history is especially important for these variables, and the conventional LSTM outperforms GRU and xLSTM in the short-history setting. AI.method: 提出一个双分支框架：(1) 利用卷积编码器提取主轴力和轴扭矩的载荷模式，LSTM骨干网络预测九个功能变量（高斯均值与方差估计）；(2) 相同载荷历史经有限元应力重构、S-N/Miner损伤评估（Haibach扩展）、Paris裂纹扩展分析，转化为输出轴疲劳信息。流式回放算法将两分支整合为功能、材料和系统可靠性轨迹。
AI.result: 留出测试显示九个输出平均2%容差精度为0.9652。热变量预测接近完美，驱动电机电流和负载速度是最具挑战的动态输出（R²分别为0.9750和0.9924）。扭矩历史对这两个变量尤为重要，传统LSTM在短历史场景下优于GRU和xLSTM。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流有效实现了功能预测与材料疲劳评估的联合，为循环工厂中产品复用决策提供了实例特定的可靠性校准方法，尤其对驱动电机电流等关键变量的过限概率预测具有实际意义。

title: SentinelBench: A Benchmark for Long-Running Monitoring Agents
summary:
AI agents are increasingly asked to carry out work that spans minutes, hours, or longer. Yet the default model of agent behavior is continuous action: issuing tool calls, refreshing pages, searching for alternatives, or otherwise trying to force progress. This is the wrong approach for many long-running tasks, which are better served by a strategy of sustained attention. Instead, agents should monitor an environment, notice when an external event makes progress possible, then respond promptly without wasting resources while waiting. To measure progress on this class of tasks, we introduce SentinelBench, an open-source benchmark for time-evolving monitoring tasks.
  SentinelBench contains 100 tasks across 10 synthetic web environments, including email, calendars, finance, professional networking, and entertainment. Each environment exposes a live web interface and replays a scripted sequence of events, requiring agents to navigate and reason about web pages whose state shifts underfoot. SentinelBench measures task completion, reaction time, and resource use, exposing the tradeoff between responsiveness and cost. We report results across three models and two browser-agent harnesses, establishing performance baselines for future comparison and demonstrating how agent design choices can dramatically impact key metrics. Together, these results show that SentinelBench distinguishes meaningful differences in agent behavior.

title: An interpretable and trustworthy AI framework for large-scale longitudinal structure-pain association studies using data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI)
summary: Purpose: To develop an interpretable and trustworthy AI framework that combines deep learning based MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) prediction with interpretable statistical modeling to study structure-pain relationships at scale using data from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI). Materials and Methods: We first developed a deep learning framework to predict MOAKS features directly from knee MRIs and incorporated conformal prediction to provide prediction uncertainty quantification. This uncertainty-aware strategy enables explicit filtering of model outputs, retaining only high-confidence MOAKS predictions at the knee level. Second, we applied a longitudinal latent class mixed model (LCMM) to examine associations between key structural abnormalities and four complementary knee pain measurements. Results: Among the three MRI-defined abnormalities (i.e., bone marrow lesions (BML), cartilage loss (CART), and meniscal extrusion (ME)), our framework substantially improved the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) and some other metrics. For example, MCC increased from 0.69 to 0.91 for BML, from 0.45 to 0.80 for CART, and from 0.59 to 0.89 for ME. Using these high-confidence predictions, we expanded the sample size to 2,175 knees for the LCMM analysis. Two distinct pain trajectories were identified (rapid and stable pain progression). The estimated odds ratios (95% CI) for the rapid progression group were 1.62 (1.12-2.35) for BML, 1.83 (1.24-2.70) for CART loss, and 2.50 (1.75-3.57) for ME. Conclusion: These results highlight the importance of these structural abnormalities as risk factors for pain and functional progression in osteoarthritis.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个结合深度学习MOAKS预测与共形预测不确定性量化的可解释AI框架，显著提高了骨关节炎结构异常的预测准确率（MCC提升至0.80-0.91），并通过LCMM模型识别出两种疼痛进展轨迹，量化了骨髓病变、软骨损失和半月板挤压作为疼痛快速进展的风险因素。
AI.motivation: 开发一种可解释且可信赖的AI框架，结合基于深度学习的MRI骨关节炎膝关节评分（MOAKS）预测与可解释统计建模，利用骨关节炎倡议（OAI）数据大规模研究结构-疼痛关系。
AI.method: 首先开发深度学习框架直接从膝关节MRI预测MOAKS特征，并引入共形预测提供预测不确定性量化，实现高置信度MOAKS预测的过滤筛选。其次，应用纵向潜在类别混合模型（LCMM）分析关键结构异常与四种互补性膝关节疼痛测量之间的关联。
AI.result: 框架显著提高了骨关节炎MRI异常（骨髓病变、软骨损失、半月板挤压）的MCC等指标：BML从0.69提高到0.91，CART从0.45提高到0.80，ME从0.59提高到0.89。利用高置信度预测将样本量扩大至2,175个膝关节进行LCMM分析，识别出快速和稳定两种疼痛进展轨迹，快速进展组的优势比分别为BML 1.62，CART loss 1.83，ME 2.50。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果强调了骨关节炎中这些结构异常作为疼痛和功能进展风险因素的重要性。
idea_en: A deep learning framework for predicting MOAKS features from knee MRIs with conformal prediction-based uncertainty quantification, enabling automatic filtering of low-confidence predictions to improve classification accuracy of osteoarthritis structural abnormalities.

A longitudinal latent class mixed model (LCMM) analysis method that leverages high-confidence deep learning predictions to expand sample size, identifying two distinct knee pain trajectories (rapid and stable progression) and quantifying odds ratios linking structural abnormalities to pain progression.

An interpretable AI framework combining uncertainty-aware deep prediction with statistical modeling for large-scale study of structure-pain relationships in osteoarthritis, applicable to other medical imaging-clinical outcome association studies.

A multi-modal risk stratification method for knee osteoarthritis based on MRI structural abnormalities (bone marrow lesions, cartilage loss, meniscal extrusion) with conformal prediction confidence filtering to build pain progression risk prediction models.

一种纵向潜在类别混合模型（LCMM）分析方法，利用高置信度深度学习预测结果扩大样本量，识别膝关节疼痛快速进展与稳定进展两种不同轨迹，并量化结构异常与疼痛进展的关联风险比。
一种结合不确定性感知深度预测与统计建模的可解释AI框架，用于大规模研究骨关节炎结构-疼痛关系，可应用于其他医学影像-临床结局关联研究。

title: Synthetic Contrastive Reasoning for Multi-Table Q&A
summary: Multi-table question answering requires models to retrieve relevant evidence, link schemas, and perform compositional reasoning across relational tables. Existing multi-table Q&A resources typically provide questions and final answers but lack reasoning supervision that explains how answers are derived. To address this gap, we construct a synthetic contrastive reasoning-trace dataset for MMQA by generating validated positive traces and plausible negative traces with heterogeneous LLMs. We then use the resulting preference pairs to fine-tune open-weight LLMs with Contrastive Preference Optimization (CPO). Across Qwen3-14B, Mistral-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B, CPO achieves absolute average improvements over Q&A supervised fine-tuning ranging from 9.7%-16.3%, with gains up to 21 percentage points on MMQA. Ablations show that heterogeneous positive and negative trace generators strengthen the contrastive signal, and automated as well as human evaluations indicate that the generated pairs are largely faithful, coherent, and meaningfully contrastive.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了多表问答的合成对比推理轨迹数据集，通过对比偏好优化（CPO）微调开源大模型，在多表问答任务上取得了显著提升（9.7%-16.3%绝对平均提升）。
AI.motivation: 现有跨表问答数据集仅提供问题和最终答案，缺乏推理过程的监督信号，导致模型难以学习如何跨表进行组合推理。
AI.method: 1）使用异构大模型生成验证过的正例推理轨迹和合理的负例轨迹，构建对比推理轨迹数据集；2）利用对比偏好优化（CPO）对开源大模型进行偏好微调。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-14B、Mistral-8B、Llama-3.1-8B上，CPO相比标准QA监督微调取得9.7%-16.3%的绝对平均提升，在MMQA上最高提升21个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 异构的正负例轨迹生成器增强了对比信号，生成的轨迹对在忠实性、连贯性和对比性方面表现良好。
idea_en: A method for constructing synthetic contrastive reasoning traces using heterogeneous LLMs as both positive and negative trace generators for multi-table QA.
A contrastive preference optimization (CPO) fine-tuning framework that leverages positive vs. negative reasoning trajectories to improve multi-table compositional reasoning.
A preference pair generation pipeline with automated and human validation to ensure faithfulness, coherence, and meaningful contrastiveness of reasoning traces.
idea_ch: 一种利用异构大模型作为正负例推理轨迹生成器来构建合成对比推理轨迹数据集的方法。
一种基于对比偏好优化（CPO）的微调框架，通过正负推理轨迹对比来提升跨表组合推理能力。
一种包含自动化和人工验证的偏好对生成流水线，确保推理轨迹的忠实性、连贯性和有意义的对比性。

title: Stability vs. Manipulability: Evaluating Robustness Under Post-Decision Interaction in LLM Judges
comment: Accepted at ACL 2026 GEM (Generation, Evaluation and Metrics) Workshop
summary: LLM-as-judge evaluation is widely used in benchmarking pipelines, where model outputs are compared and ranked using automated evaluators. These pipelines typically assume that judgments are stable properties of fixed inputs. We show that this assumption does not hold under interaction. We study post-decision manipulability: the extent to which an evaluation outcome can be altered through subsequent conversation with the judge after an initial decision has been made. Across controlled experiments on MT-Bench and AlpacaEval, we find that LLM judges are highly stable under repeated and neutral reevaluation, yet become substantially reversible under targeted post-decision challenge. An anti-baseline challenge protocol shows that stable judgments can be overturned through motivated interaction, while a counterbalanced target-validation protocol separates this reversibility from net target-directed steering. These reversals have practical consequences: they can degrade agreement with human preferences, shift benchmark rankings, and produce harmful evaluation changes despite high self-reported confidence. Authority framing is especially destabilizing, and revised judgments are often accompanied by low-overlap justifications, suggesting post hoc rationalization rather than reliable error correction. We introduce the Evaluation Robustness Score (ERS) to quantify interactional robustness by combining reversal susceptibility with counterbalanced directional effects. Our findings identify post-decision interaction as a distinct failure mode for LLM-as-judge evaluation and motivate evaluation protocols that measure not only static agreement, but robustness under challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM作为评审者在做出初始判断后，通过后续对话可以显著改变其评估结果，揭示了“后决策可操纵性”这一新的失效模式，并提出了评估鲁棒性评分（ERS）来衡量交互鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM-as-judge评估框架假设判断是固定输入的稳定属性，忽略了交互场景下评估结果可能被操纵的问题。本文旨在揭示后决策交互对LLM评审稳定性的影响。
AI.method: 在MT-Bench和AlpacaEval上进行对照实验，采用抗基线挑战协议和平衡目标验证协议，通过后续对话对已做出的判断进行挑战，分析逆转率、置信度、与人类偏好的一致性等指标，并引入评估鲁棒性评分（ERS）。
AI.result: LLM评审在重复中性重评估下高度稳定，但受到针对性后决策挑战时可被显著逆转。逆转导致与人类偏好一致性下降、基准排名偏移、产生有害评估变化。权威框架最具破坏性，修改后的判断常伴随低重叠性理由，表明存在事后合理化而非可靠的错误修正。
AI.conclusion: 后决策交互是LLM-as-judge评估的一个独特失效模式，评估协议不仅应衡量静态一致性，还应测量在挑战下的鲁棒性。ERS为量化交互鲁棒性提供了有效工具。
idea_en: A method for evaluating the interactional robustness of LLM judges by measuring reversal susceptibility and counterbalanced directional effects through post-decision challenge protocols
A system for detecting and quantifying post-decision manipulability in LLM evaluation pipelines using anti-baseline challenge and target-validation protocols
An Evaluation Robustness Score (ERS) that combines reversal susceptibility with counterbalanced directional effects to quantify how resistant an LLM judge is to interactional manipulation
A technique for identifying post hoc rationalization in revised LLM judgments by analyzing justification overlap between initial and post-challenge evaluations
A method for improving benchmark reliability by incorporating robustness-under-challenge metrics alongside static agreement metrics in LLM-as-judge evaluation pipelines
idea_ch: 一种基于后决策挑战协议的LLM评审交互鲁棒性评估方法，通过测量逆转敏感性和平衡方向效应来量化评审稳定性
一种利用抗基线挑战协议和平衡目标验证协议检测LLM评估流水线中后决策可操纵性的系统
评估鲁棒性评分（ERS），结合逆转敏感性与平衡方向效应，量化LLM评审对交互操纵的抵抗能力
一种识别LLM修订判断中事后合理化的技术，通过分析初始评估与挑战后评估之间的理由重叠度
一种在LLM-as-judge评估流水线中结合静态一致性与挑战鲁棒性指标的基准可靠性改进方法

title: Residual Modeling for High-Fidelity Learned Compression of Scientific Data
summary:
Lossy compression is essential for massive spatiotemporal data from scientific simulations. Learned compressors can achieve high compression ratios at moderate accuracy targets, but their aggregate reconstruction losses do not guarantee accuracy for each block. Existing Guaranteed Autoencoder (GAE) methods add a per-block residual correction by retaining SVD/PCA-style coefficients until the target is met. This works at moderate tolerances, but in the high-fidelity regime with block-level NRMSE from 10^-6 to 10^-4, the number of retained coefficients grows quickly and the correction stream dominates the total rate.
  We propose a residual-centric view: the learned residual is structurally different from the original scientific field and should be coded with a representation designed for that residual. We introduce two residual coders. LBRC is a deterministic, training-free pipeline that adaptively quantizes the learned residual to the target NRMSE and losslessly encodes the resulting integer residual using 3D Lorenzo differencing, zigzag mapping, bit-plane coding, and entropy coding. NGLR adds a causal neural predictor that outputs a normalized bias for an integer-rounded Lorenzo prediction in the same deterministic integer pipeline, reducing the entropy of the remaining residual code while preserving deterministic decoding. The predictor weights are serialized and counted in the bitstream.
  Across E3SM, JHTDB, and ERA5 at block-level NRMSE targets from 10^-6 to 10^-4, LBRC improves compression ratio over GAE by 30-60% and is broadly competitive with SZ. NGLR adds a further 10-40% over LBRC and outperforms SZ in the evaluated high-fidelity regime. These results show that residual representations tailored to learned-compressor residuals can preserve the advantage of learned compression when global residual correction becomes rate-dominant.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种面向学习压缩器残差的专门编码器（LBRC和NGLR），在高保真度场景下显著提升压缩比，优于GAE和SZ方法。
AI.motivation: 现有GAE方法在高保真度下残差校正流占据主导码率，导致压缩效率下降。
AI.method: LBRC采用无训练确定性流水线，通过自适应量化、3D Lorenzo差分、Z字形映射、位平面编码和熵编码对残差编码；NGLR在此基础上引入因果神经预测器，对Lorenzo预测进行归一化偏置校正，降低残差熵。
AI.result: 在E3SM、JHTDB、ERA5数据集上，NRMSE目标10^-6至10^-4，LBRC相比GAE提升30-60%压缩比，NGLR再额外提升10-40%，并优于SZ。
AI.conclusion: 针对学习压缩器残差设计的专用表示方法，能在全局残差校正成为码率主导时保持学习压缩的优势。
idea_en: A deterministic, training-free residual coding pipeline (LBRC) that adaptively quantizes learned residuals to a target NRMSE and losslessly encodes using 3D Lorenzo differencing, zigzag mapping, bit-plane coding, and entropy coding.

A causal neural predictor integrated into an integer residual coding pipeline (NGLR) that outputs a normalized bias for integer-rounded Lorenzo prediction to reduce residual entropy while preserving deterministic decoding.
A bitstream structure that serializes neural predictor weights alongside the coded residual stream, enabling causal neural prediction within a fully deterministic compression framework.
idea_ch: 一种无训练的确定性残差编码流水线（LBRC），将学习残差自适应量化到目标NRMSE，结合3D Lorenzo差分、Z字形映射、位平面编码和熵编码进行无损编码。
一种集成因果神经预测器的整数残差编码方法（NGLR），通过对整数取整的Lorenzo预测输出归一化偏置，在保持确定性解码的同时降低残差熵。
一种将神经预测器权重序列化并计入比特流的编码结构，在完全确定性的压缩框架中实现因果神经预测。

title: LeanMarathon: Toward Reliable AI Co-Mathematicians through Long-Horizon Lean Autoformalization
summary: Long-horizon autoformalization of research mathematics fails not only at hard lemmas, but at scale: statements drift, dependencies tangle, context decays, and local repairs corrupt distant work. We present LeanMarathon, a multi-agent harness for reliable research-level Lean autoformalization. Its core abstraction is an evolving blueprint: a Lean file that serves simultaneously as formal proof skeleton, natural-language proof graph, and shared system of record. Four contract-scoped agents construct, audit, prove, and repair this blueprint. These agents are coordinated by a two-stage orchestrator that first stabilizes target fidelity through adversarial review and then discharges the proof directed acyclic graph (DAG) from its dynamic leaves upward in parallel CI-gated rounds. LeanMarathon turns one brittle multi-hour run into many local, recoverable, parallel transactions. We evaluate LeanMarathon on two recent research papers spanning four Erdős problems (#1051, #1196, #164, #1217). Across three autonomous runs, it formalizes all seven target theorems with no sorry, proving 258 lemmas and theorems. These results show that reliable AI co-mathematics requires not only stronger provers, but durable harnesses that preserve target fidelity across long mathematical developments. The code can be found at https://github.com/YuanheZ/LeanMarathon.

AI.tldr: LeanMarathon是一个多智能体框架，通过演化蓝图（同时作为形式化证明骨架、自然语言证明图和共享系统记录）和两阶段编排器（先对抗审校稳定目标保真度，再并行CI门控从动态叶节点向上消解证明DAG），实现了面向研究级数学的可靠长时序自动形式化，在四个Erdős问题的七个定理上均无需sorry即可完成形式化。
AI.motivation: 现有长时序自动形式化面临语句漂移、依赖缠绕、上下文衰减、局部修复破坏远端工作等系统性问题，需要一种能在大规模长时序数学开发中保持目标保真度的可靠框架。
AI.method: 提出LeanMarathon框架，核心是演化蓝图机制（Lean文件同时作为形式化证明骨架+自然语言证明图+系统记录），四类合约智能体（构建、审计、证明、修复）协同工作，两阶段编排器：第一阶段通过对抗审校稳定目标保真度，第二阶段从动态叶节点向上并行CI门控消解证明DAG。
AI.result: 在两篇研究论文、四个Erdős问题（#1051, #1196, #164, #1217）的七个目标定理上，三次自主运行均实现完全形式化（无sorry），证明了258个引理和定理。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的AI辅助数学合作不仅需要更强的证明器，还需要能在大规模数学开发中保持目标保真度的持久化框架。长时序自动形式化的核心瓶颈是系统性的，需要架构级别的解决方案。
idea_en: Evolving Blueprint mechanism: a Lean file serving simultaneously as formal proof skeleton, natural-language proof graph, and shared system of record for multi-agent collaboration
Two-stage orchestrator with adversarial review for target fidelity stabilization followed by parallel CI-gated DAG discharge from dynamic leaves
Contract-scoped agent architecture with four specialized roles (construct, audit, prove, repair) for reliable long-horizon autoformalization
Dynamic leaf-upward parallel proof DAG discharge strategy with CI gating for fault isolation and recovery
Blueprint-based multi-agent harness that transforms one brittle multi-hour run into many local, recoverable, parallel transactions

两阶段编排器：第一阶段通过对抗性审校稳定目标保真度，第二阶段从动态叶节点向上并行CI门控消解证明DAG
合约范围的智能体架构：四种专业化角色（构建、审计、证明、修复）实现可靠的长时序自动形式化

title: Harnessing Generalist Agents for Contextualized Time Series
summary: Time series are often embedded in rich contexts that are essential for holistic modeling. Moreover, real-world practitioners often require end-to-end workflows for analyzing temporal dynamics, where widely studied tasks such as forecasting are only one step in a broader solution loop. While generalist AI agents offer a promising interface for such workflows under complex contexts, they still operate primarily in textual spaces that are not fully aligned with structured temporal signals. In this work, we introduce TimeClaw, an agentic harness framework for time series that equips generalist LLM agents with the time series-native runtime support needed for contextualized temporal reasoning. TimeClaw integrates executable temporal tools for grounded and auditable analysis, experience-driven capability evolution for creating reusable analytical routines, and episodic multimodal memory for retrieving relevant reasoning traces. Together, these components unlock harnessed open-ended temporal reasoning with contextual information. Extensive evaluation on multiple benchmarks covering diverse tasks across energy, finance, weather, traffic, and other real-world domains demonstrates improved performance of TimeClaw. Code is available at https://github.com/iDEA-iSAIL-Lab-UIUC/TimeClaw.

AI.tldr: TimeClaw是一个为时间序列分析设计的智能体框架，通过集成可执行的时间工具、经验驱动的能力演进和情景多模态记忆，增强通用大语言模型在时间序列上的上下文推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有通用AI智能体主要操作在文本空间，未能充分对齐结构化时间信号；实际时间序列分析需要端到端工作流，而传统方法仅关注预测等单一任务，缺乏对丰富上下文的整合能力。
AI.method: TimeClaw包含三个核心组件：1) 可执行时间工具（用于基于事实的分析与审计）；2) 经验驱动能力演进（创建可复用的分析例程）；3) 情景多模态记忆（检索相关推理轨迹）。三者协同实现带上下文信息的开放式时间推理。
AI.result: 在能源、金融、天气、交通等多个真实世界领域的多个基准测试上，TimeClaw展现了显著优于现有方法的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: TimeClaw通过赋予通用LLM智能体时间序列原生运行时支持，有效弥合了文本空间与结构化时间信号之间的鸿沟，为上下文时间推理提供了可行的框架方案。
idea_en: 1. A harness framework that equips generalist LLM agents with time-series-native runtime support for contextualized temporal reasoning, integrating executable temporal tools, experience-driven capability evolution, and episodic multimodal memory.
2. Executable temporal tools for grounded and auditable time series analysis, enabling LLM agents to perform verifiable operations on structured temporal data.
3. Experience-driven capability evolution mechanism for creating and reusing analytical routines in time series analysis workflows.
4. Episodic multimodal memory system for retrieving relevant reasoning traces from past temporal analysis experiences to inform current decision-making.
5. An end-to-end agentic workflow system that transforms traditional single-task time series analysis (e.g., forecasting) into a holistic, context-aware solution loop.
idea_ch: 1. 一种为通用大语言模型智能体赋予时间序列原生运行时支持的框架，集成可执行时间工具、经验驱动能力演进和情景多模态记忆，实现上下文时间推理。
2. 可执行时间工具模块，使LLM智能体能够在结构化时间数据上执行可审计、可验证的分析操作。
3. 经验驱动能力演进机制，用于在时间序列分析工作流中创建和复用可重复使用的分析例程。
4. 情景多模态记忆系统，从历史时间分析经验中检索相关推理轨迹以辅助当前决策。
5. 一种端到端智能体工作流系统，将传统单任务时间序列分析（如预测）转变为全流程、上下文感知的解决方案闭环。

title: Agents' Last Exam
summary: Recent AI systems have achieved strong results on a wide range of benchmarks, yet these gains have not translated into economically meaningful deployment across many professional domains. We argue that this gap is largely an evaluation problem: widely used benchmarks lack sustained performance measurement on real and economically valuable workflows. This paper introduces Agents' Last Exam (ALE), a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents on long-horizon, economically valuable, real-world tasks with verifiable outcomes. Developed in collaboration with 250+ industry experts, ALE covers non-physical industries defined with reference to O*NET / SOC 2018 (the U.S. federal occupational taxonomy). It is organized around a task taxonomy with 55 subfields grouped into 13 industry clusters covering 1K+ tasks. Current results show that the hardest tier remains far from saturated: across mainstream harness and backbone configurations, the average full pass rate is 2.6%. ALE is designed as a living benchmark: its task pool grows continuously as new workflows and industries are onboarded. More broadly, ALE is intended not merely as another leaderboard, but as an instrument for closing the gap between benchmark success and GDP-relevant impact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agents' Last Exam (ALE)，一个由250+行业专家协作构建的基准测试，用于评估AI代理在长期、经济价值高的真实工作任务上的表现。当前最困难的任务通过率仅2.6%，ALE是持续增长的动态基准。
AI.motivation: 当前AI在基准测试上表现优异，但未转化为专业领域的经济性部署，这一差距主要是评估问题：现有基准缺乏对真实经济价值工作流的持续性能测量。
AI.method: 与250+行业专家合作，依据O*NET/SOC 2018美国联邦职业分类，构建涵盖55个子领域、13个行业集群、1000+任务的基准测试ALE，聚焦长期、可验证结果的真实经济任务。
AI.result: 在最困难层级，主流模型配置的平均完全通过率仅为2.6%，表明该基准远未饱和。
AI.conclusion: ALE作为持续增长的动态基准，旨在缩小基准测试成功与GDP相关影响之间的差距，而非简单的排行榜。

title: Mutation Without Variation: Convergence Dynamics in LLM-Driven Program Evolution
comment: Accepted to the Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference (GECCO '26) Workshop on Large Language Models for and with Evolutionary Computation
summary: When an LLM repeatedly mutates a program, does it explore new forms or circle back to the same ones? We study this question by analyzing LLM-driven mutation chains in the absence of selection pressure within a domain-specific language, varying prompt design, model family, and stochastic replication. We find that LLM-based mutation consistently converges toward restricted attractor regions in program space. Convergence is especially severe at the structural level: in 87% of chains, over 93% of mutations revisit a previously seen structural form, with most variation confined to terminal substitutions within recurring templates. Cycle analysis reveals short cycles and self-loops dominating the transition structure. The rate of convergence varies with prompt wording and model choice, but the phenomenon is robust across conditions. A classical GP subtree mutation operator does not exhibit comparable convergence, suggesting that the effect is intrinsic to the LLM mutation pipeline. These findings reveal a tension at the heart of LLM-driven program evolution: the same capabilities that enable semantics-aware program transformation also carry a systematic bias toward structural homogeneity that must be accounted for if such systems are to sustain open-ended exploration. Source code is available at https://github.com/can-gurkan/lmca.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了LLM在无选择压力下对程序进行重复突变时的行为，发现LLM驱动的突变会持续收敛到程序空间中的受限吸引子区域，87%的突变链中超过93%的突变重复出现先前见过的结构形式，表明LLM存在固有的结构同质性偏差。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM在反复突变程序时，是否真正探索新形式还是会循环回到旧形式，揭示LLM驱动程序演化的内在行为模式。

AI.result: LLM突变持续收敛到吸引子区域；87%链中超过93%突变是结构重复；循环分析显示短周期和自循环占主导；收敛速率受提示措辞和模型选择影响但现象稳健；经典GP突变算子未表现出类似收敛。
AI.conclusion: LLM的语义感知能力使其擅长程序变换，但同时也带来了系统性的结构同质化偏差，这会限制开放式的程序探索。

title: A Motivational Architecture for Conversational AGI
summary: Motivational architectures in cognitive AI have largely been designed for physical agents regulating bodily needs. Conversational agents operate in a different regime: their sensorimotor loop is linguistic, their environment is a user's evolving mental state, and their consequential actions are speech acts, tool invocations, and strategic silences. This paper proposes a conversational reinterpretation of the OpenPsi motivational lineage, coupled to MetaMo's higher-level motivational scaffold, for agents built on a modular execution substrate. Homeostasis is recast in dialogue-native terms: the agent regulates competence, uncertainty reduction, affiliation, affinity, legitimacy, nurturing, and aesthetic coherence rather than bodily deficits. We propose three contributions: a ten-stage motivational processing pipeline that architecturally separates cognitive modulation from situational appraisal; a dual decision strategy blending urgency-driven fast response with deliberative multi-goal optimization; and an architecturally useful distinction between pre-action feelings and post-action emotions as functionally different forms of affect. We specialize the framework to two example agents -- CompanionAgent and ResearchAgent -- and sketch its extension to social robotics and domain-generic human-level AGI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于对话的动机架构，将OpenPsi动机谱系重新解释为适用于对话智能体，通过十阶段处理流水线、双决策策略以及行动前感受与行动后情绪的功能区分，管理语言交互中的动机状态。
AI.motivation: 认知AI中的动机架构大多为调节身体需求的物理智能体设计，而对话智能体工作在不同方式：其感知运动环是语言性的，环境是用户不断变化的心理状态，行为是言语行为、工具调用和策略性沉默。因此需要重新设计适用于对话智能体的动机架构。

AI.result: 构建了适用于对话智能体的动机架构框架，并通过CompanionAgent和ResearchAgent两个示例智能体进行具体化，展示了框架的实用性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该架构可扩展到社交机器人和通用人类级AGI，为对话智能体的动机系统设计提供了新范式。

title: Assessing the Carbon Emissions and Energy Consumption of U.S. Hyperscale Data Centers
summary: The rapid proliferation of hyperscale data centers (HDCs) in the US, mainly driven by the adoption of artificial intelligence, has raised concerns about this industry's environmental footprint. We compiled facility-level information on 403 US hyperscale data centers operating between May 2024 and April 2025 and estimated their electricity consumption, electricity sources, and attributable CO2 emissions. Across different facility-load scenarios, these HDCs consumed approximately 68-99 TWh of electricity and were associated with about 37-54 million metric tons of CO2. Under the central scenario, HDC electricity demand corresponded to approximately 1.8% of total US electricity consumption, with roughly 54% of attributed generation supplied by fossil-fuel sources. The HDC electricity-weighted average carbon intensity was approximately 545 gCO2/kWh, about 48% above the contemporaneous US national grid-average carbon intensity of 370 gCO2/kWh. Our approach provides an attributional tool for assessing the environmental footprint of hyperscale data centers using the most recent EPA eGRID plant-level data.

AI.tldr: 该研究汇编了2024年5月至2025年4月期间美国403个超大规模数据中心的设施级信息，估算了其电力消耗、电力来源和可归因的CO2排放。在中心情景下，这些HDC消耗约68-99 TWh电力，产生约37-54百万吨CO2，占美国总电力消耗约1.8%，其中约54%来自化石燃料，碳强度比美国国家电网平均高出约48%。
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能的广泛采用，美国超大规模数据中心迅速扩张，但其环境足迹（尤其是电力消耗和碳排放）缺乏系统性的设施级量化评估，亟需建立归因分析工具来准确评估这一新兴产业的生态影响。
AI.method: 汇编了403个美国超大规模数据中心的设施级信息，使用EPA eGRID电厂级最新数据，通过不同设施负载情景估算电力消耗、电力来源和可归因的CO2排放，采用归因性分析方法评估环境足迹。
AI.result: HDC消耗约68-99 TWh电力，产生约37-54百万吨CO2；中心情景下占美国总电力消耗约1.8%；约54%来自化石燃料；碳强度约545 gCO2/kWh，比美国国家电网平均碳强度（370 gCO2/kWh）高出约48%。
AI.conclusion: 超大规模数据中心的碳强度显著高于美国电网平均水平，主要由于依赖化石燃料供电，这突显了该行业在AI驱动下快速发展所带来的环境挑战，也为制定减碳政策提供了定量依据。

title: Minimizing the Hidden Cost of Scales: Graph-Guided Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization for Large Language Models
comment: Preprint. 18 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables, including appendix
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is critical for the efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs). Recent ultra-low-bit PTQ methods rely on rigid weight-saliency assumptions or position heuristics, introducing substantial hidden scaling overhead. We propose SAGE-PTQ (Saliency-Aware Graph-guided Efficient PTQ), a novel ultra-low-bit quantization framework for LLMs that minimizes hidden scaling cost. SAGE-PTQ separates salient and unsalient weights using distributional statistics, then models subsampled unsalient weights as a sparse graph to estimate the optimal number of groups per layer. SAGE-PTQ applies dual-mode quantization, assigning multi-bit precision to salient weights and binarizing unsalient weights. To reduce scaling overhead, SAGE-PTQ uses one per-channel scale for salient weights and one scalar per unsalient group. Finally, SAGE-PTQ implements adaptive saliency thresholding to select the optimal saliency ratio per matrix. SAGE-PTQ achieves 1.03 weight bits and only 0.004 scaling bits per matrix on average, outperforming state-of-the-art methods such as BiLLM and PB-LLM. On LLaMA-3-8B, SAGE-PTQ achieves 6.74 WikiText2 perplexity, compared to 55.8 for BiLLM, while using less than 50% of BiLLM's GPU memory. On LLaMA-2-70B, SAGE-PTQ provides 1.5x faster decoding on one NVIDIA L40 GPU, demonstrating practical inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: SAGE-PTQ提出了一种基于显著性感知和图引导的超低位宽量化框架，通过分离显著/非显著权重、稀疏图建模分组、双模态量化及自适应阈值技术，在极低比特率下实现LLM高效部署。
AI.motivation: 现有超低位宽PTQ方法依赖刚性的权重显著性假设或位置启发式方法，引入大量隐藏的缩放开销，导致实际推理效率受限。
AI.method: 1) 利用分布统计分离显著/非显著权重；2) 将子采样后的非显著权重建模为稀疏图，估计每层最优分组数；3) 双模态量化：显著权重用多比特精度，非显著权重二值化；4) 显著权重使用每通道一个缩放因子，非显著组使用一个标量缩放因子；5) 自适应显著性阈值选择每矩阵最优显著性比率。
AI.result: 平均每矩阵1.03权重比特和0.004缩放比特；LLaMA-3-8B上WikiText2困惑度6.74（BiLLM为55.8），GPU内存消耗不到BiLLM的50%；LLaMA-2-70B上单L40 GPU解码速度提升1.5倍。
AI.conclusion: SAGE-PTQ通过图引导的分组和自适应显著性阈值，在极低比特率下显著降低了隐藏缩放开销，兼顾了模型精度与推理效率。

title: Zero knowledge verification for frontier AI training is possible
summary: Frontier AI governance frameworks increasingly use cumulative training compute as the primary criterion for designating high-impact models, but enforcement rests on self-reporting because no technical verification primitive for training exists. Any future international agreement on frontier AI faces the same problem at higher stakes: coordinated regulation of technologies with significant externalities has historically rested on technical verification, without which agreements are declaratory. Recent governance analyses judge zero-knowledge proofs a promising candidate but currently impractical at frontier scale [26, 4]. We argue the impracticality is paradigm-bound rather than fundamental, and propose a verification architecture for frontier dense pre-training combining a pre-committed training specification, inter-node network observations, and on-the-fly Merkle commitments of intermediate computation, verified through a zero-knowledge Virtual Machine (zkVM) with native BF16/FP32 precompiles. The proof checks the actual floating-point computation the GPU performed rather than a fixed-point approximation, and preserves model-architecture confidentiality through a private training specification. The protocol produces three proof types: a genesis proof at initialisation, in-training step proofs across the run, and ex-ante attestations enforcing policy-relevant claims as running invariants, turning the training record into a governance-enforceable artefact. We estimate a deployable proof of concept within approximately 36 months at single-digit-percent training-side overhead, against a six-to-ten-year cycle for verification-grade custom silicon. Thirteen open research and engineering problems are catalogued as a research agenda for external contribution

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于零知识证明（zkVM）的前沿AI预训练验证架构，通过结合训练规范预承诺、网络观察、Merkle承诺和BF16/FP32原生预编译，实现对累计训练计算量的可验证证明，使训练记录成为可治理执行的技术产物。预计36个月内可实现概念验证，训练侧开销仅个位数百分比。
AI.motivation: 当前AI治理框架依赖自我报告的累计训练算力来界定高风险模型，但缺乏技术验证原语。任何未来国际AI协议都面临同样问题：历史上具有显著外部性的技术协调监管都依赖技术验证，否则协议仅为声明性。现有分析认为零知识证明有前景但在前沿规模下不实用，本文论证该不实用性是范式限制而非根本性限制。
AI.method: 提出一种验证架构，包括：(1) 预提交的训练规范；(2) 节点间网络观测；(3) 中间计算的即时Merkle承诺；(4) 通过具有原生BF16/FP32预编译的零知识虚拟机（zkVM）进行验证。该证明检查GPU实际执行的浮点运算而非定点近似，并通过私有训练规范保护模型架构机密性。产生三种证明类型：初始化时的创世证明、运行中的步骤证明、以及将策略相关声明作为运行不变量的事前证明。
AI.result: 估计在约36个月内可实现可部署的概念验证，训练侧开销为个位数百分比，相比之下验证级定制芯片需要6-10年周期。同时列出了13个开放研究与工程问题作为外部贡献的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: AI训练可验证性问题在技术上是可解的，零知识证明的不实用性是范式局限而非根本限制。所提出的架构可将训练记录转化为可治理执行的技术产物，为国际AI治理协议提供技术验证基础。

title: Ten Headache Specialists versus Artificial Intelligence for Clinical Literature Summarization: A Critical Evaluation and Comparison
summary: Summarizing the latest medical literature to guide clinical decision-making is essential for evidence-based medicine and high-quality patient care. Yet clinicians face increasing challenges due to limited time with patients and a rapidly growing volume of published articles. Although retrieval-augmented large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in clinical summarization, human evaluations of their effectiveness in synthesizing broader scientific literature and direct comparisons to expert-written syntheses remain scarce. We constructed a RAG-based agentic AI framework using three state-of-the-art LLMs: Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Llama 3.1. A headache specialist created 13 questions, three for prompt optimization and ten for evaluation. Ten headache specialists across the United States and Canada each wrote a summary for one question, yielding four summaries per question (expert, Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Llama). The experts, blinded to authorship, critically evaluated the summaries, excluding the topic for which they wrote a summary, based on correctness, completeness, conciseness, and clinical utility, scoring each from 1 to 10 using standardized rubrics. They also ranked the summaries by preference and indicated whether they believed each summary was written by an expert or an LLM. Our study, comparing LLM- and expert-written literature summaries evaluated by headache specialists, showed that expert-written summaries were preferred, although experts sometimes found it challenging to distinguish between human- and AI-generated summaries. We also identified key expert-valued features beyond standard evaluation metrics that can guide future refinement of both human and AI literature summarization pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个基于RAG的智能AI框架（使用Sonnet、GPT-4o、Llama 3.1），对比了AI生成的医学文献摘要与头痛专家撰写的摘要。10位专家盲评后发现专家摘要更优，但有时难以区分AI与人类摘要，并识别出专家重视的关键特征以指导未来改进。
AI.motivation: 临床医生面临时间有限和文献量快速增长的双重挑战，需要自动化工具来总结最新医学文献以支持循证决策。尽管检索增强型LLM在临床总结方面有前景，但缺乏人类对其综合科学文献效果的系统评估，以及与专家撰写摘要的直接比较。
AI.method: 1. 构建基于RAG的智能AI框架，使用Sonnet、GPT-4o、Llama 3.1三种模型；2. 头痛专家创建13个问题（3个用于提示优化，10个用于评估）；3. 10位头痛专家每人撰写一个问题的人类摘要；4. 每个问题生成4种摘要（专家、Sonnet、GPT-4o、Llama）；5. 专家盲评，基于正确性、完整性、简洁性、临床效用打分（1-10分），并排序和判断来源。
AI.result: 专家撰写的摘要总体更受偏好，但专家有时难以区分人类与AI生成的摘要。识别出了超出标准评价指标的专家重视的关键特征。
AI.conclusion: 目前的AI摘要尚不及专家水平，但已具备一定迷惑性；未来可根据专家重视的关键特征改进AI及人类的文献摘要生成流程。
idea_en: A RAG-based agentic AI framework for medical literature summarization that integrates multiple state-of-the-art LLMs (Sonnet, GPT-4o, Llama 3.1) with a standardized evaluation rubric covering correctness, completeness, conciseness, and clinical utility.

A blinded expert evaluation methodology for comparing AI-generated and human-written medical literature summaries, including a source-identification task to measure indistinguishability between AI and human outputs.
Identification of key expert-valued features beyond standard metrics (correctness, completeness, conciseness, clinical utility) for guiding refinement of AI literature summarization pipelines.

A multi-expert, multi-question evaluation design where each expert writes a summary for one question and evaluates summaries for other questions, reducing bias in comparative assessment of AI vs. human summaries.

title: Brick-Composer: Using MLLMs for Assembly with Diverse Bricks
summary: We dream of AI agents that can read arbitrary designs and construct real-world objects from reusable building blocks. As a first step toward this vision, we study whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) possess the visual grounding and spatial reasoning capabilities required for brick assembly. We formulate brick assembly as a sequential decision-making problem, where each step involves two subtasks: brick selection, identifying the target brick from candidate components, and brick pose estimation, predicting where and how the selected brick should be placed. To support this study, we introduce BC-Bench (Brick Construction Benchmark), the first benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on assembly with diverse bricks. Experiments show that current state-of-the-art MLLMs remain far from reliable builders, struggling with fine-grained brick selection and failing at precise pose estimation. To bridge this gap, we propose Brick-Composer, a learning framework that equips MLLMs with assembly skills through three complementary signals: Human Design Sparks, which provide affordance-rich construction demonstrations; World Feedback, which grounds predicted actions in visual and physical consequences; and Synthetic Experience, which scales learning beyond existing object designs. Brick-Composer improves brick selection accuracy by over three times, substantially reduces pose estimation errors, and raises strict step-level assembly success from less than 1% to around 15%. After training, a Qwen-3-8B can correctly compose up to 42% of the steps for a complete object, suggesting that MLLMs can acquire assembly capabilities through targeted, physically grounded learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BC-Bench基准测试和Brick-Composer学习框架，用于评估和提升多模态大语言模型在积木组装任务中的视觉定位与空间推理能力，使Qwen-3-8B的步骤级组装成功率从不足1%提升至约15%。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在细粒度积木选择和精确位姿估计方面能力不足，缺乏可靠的组装能力，亟需系统性的评估基准和学习方法来提升其构建真实世界物体的能力。
AI.method: 将积木组装建模为顺序决策问题，包含积木选择和位姿估计两个子任务；提出BC-Bench基准测试；设计Brick-Composer框架，融合三种信号：人类设计灵感（提供丰富的构建演示）、世界反馈（基于视觉和物理后果约束预测动作）、合成体验（扩展学习范围）。
AI.result: Brick-Composer将积木选择准确率提升3倍以上，位姿估计误差显著降低，步骤级组装成功率从不足1%提升至约15%，Qwen-3-8B能正确组装完整物体约42%的步骤。
AI.conclusion: 多模态大语言模型通过目标导向的、基于物理的学习可以获取组装能力，但当前模型距离可靠的自主建造者仍有较大差距。
idea_en: A sequential decision-making framework for brick assembly that decomposes the task into two subtasks: brick selection (identifying target brick from candidates) and brick pose estimation (predicting placement position and orientation)

BC-Bench (Brick Construction Benchmark): a benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on assembly tasks with diverse bricks, providing standardized evaluation of visual grounding and spatial reasoning

Brick-Composer learning framework that integrates three complementary training signals: Human Design Sparks (affordance-rich construction demonstrations), World Feedback (visual and physical consequence grounding), and Synthetic Experience (scaling beyond existing designs)
A physically grounded learning approach for MLLMs that uses visual and physical consequence feedback to constrain and correct predicted assembly actions
Synthetic experience generation method that scales MLLM assembly learning beyond existing object designs by creating additional training data
Application of MLLMs to sequential physical construction tasks with brick selection and pose estimation as core decision-making components

title: Insurance of Agentic AI
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems are transforming the risk landscape by extending beyond information generation to autonomous planning, tool invocation, decision execution, and persistent modification of digital and physical environments. These capabilities introduce novel exposures that do not fit neatly within traditional insurance categories such as cyber, professional liability, product liability, or directors and officers coverage. This paper examines the emerging insurance market for agentic AI and develops a framework for understanding its underwriting, pricing, reinsurance, and product-design implications. We characterize agentic AI as a continuum of autonomy and delegated authority, emphasizing the distinction between informational outputs and systems capable of independently generating insured events through external actions. We analyze major risk pathways, including hallucinations, prompt-injection attacks, autonomous decision errors, model drift, dependency failures, and cyber-physical harms, and evaluate how existing insurance products are adapting to address these exposures. The paper further proposes an actuarial framework based on exposure assessment, scenario analysis, dependency mapping, and accumulation-risk management, drawing parallels to the evolution of cyber insurance. Finally, we present a coordinated insurance architecture that integrates cyber, technology errors and omissions, product liability, performance-warranty, and affirmative AI-liability coverages through explicit allocation mechanisms and dedicated AI aggregates. The analysis suggests that the future of agentic-AI insurance lies not in a single monoline product but in a layered ecosystem of complementary coverages supported by improved governance, transparency, telemetry, and regulatory clarity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了自主人工智能（Agentic AI）系统带来的新兴保险市场，分析了其承保、定价、再保险和产品设计的影响，并提出了一套涵盖网络、技术错误与遗漏、产品责任、性能保证及主动AI责任保险的协调保险架构。
AI.motivation: 传统保险类别（如网络安全、专业责任、产品责任、董事及高管责任）难以覆盖自主AI系统所带来的新型风险敞口，因为这类AI不仅能生成信息，还能自主规划、调用工具、执行决策并持久修改数字和物理环境，需要新的保险框架。
AI.method: 将自主AI定义为自主性和授权委托的连续谱，强调信息输出与可独立引发保险事件的外部行动系统之间的区别；分析主要风险路径（如幻觉、提示注入攻击、自主决策错误、模型漂移、依赖失效、网络物理伤害）；提出基于风险评估、场景分析、依赖映射和累积风险管理的精算框架；设计集成的保险架构。
AI.result: 现有保险产品正在逐步适应这些新风险；提出了一个协调的保险架构，整合了网络安全、技术错误与遗漏、产品责任、性能保证和主动AI责任保险，通过明确的分配机制和专用AI聚合额度来运作。
AI.conclusion: 自主AI保险的未来不在于单一的险种产品，而在于由改进的治理、透明度、遥测技术和监管清晰度支持的互补保障分层生态系统。

title: Output Type Before Quality: A Standards-Derived XAI Admissibility Rubric for Autonomous-Driving Safety
summary:
Safety standards for ML-based autonomous driving specify the kind of evidence an assurance case must contain (directed cause-and-effect chains, quantified interventional effects, named root-cause variables), yet the XAI literature is organised by output type and technique family (saliency maps, feature attribution, counterfactuals, causal graphs, language traces). SHAP, the most-recommended ADS XAI method, returns a ranked feature list that no implementation effort can convert into a directed chain (Fig.1). We name this mismatch the evidence-type gap.
  From AMLAS, ISO 26262, ISO21448, ISO/PAS 8800 we derive 19 testable evidentiary criteria across 7 lifecycle stages with representative clause-cited derivations and score six XAI method classes structurally.
  Causal XAI emerges as structurally required to satisfy the derived criteria at three stages: hazard identification (+62% rubric gap), incident investigation (+50%), and data management (+50%); the verdict set is stable across thresholds T in (0%, 50%]$ and survives a worst-case single-cell flip down to T = 25%. At the remaining four stages, correlational or language-based methods are comparable or sufficient. The rubric identifies structural admissibility (necessary but not sufficient for compliance): an admissible method's specific output content may still be wrong, and validating that fidelity (the edges a fitted SCM produces, the cause a trace names) is the open assurance challenge. A single-VLA proof of concept on 1,996 real-world driving clips (79,840 rows, ten splits) is consistent with each method's observed output type matching its rubric prediction. XAI method selection for ADS safety assurance should be driven by lifecycle-stage evidence demand, not by method popularity.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了ML自动驾驶安全标准所需的证据类型（有向因果链、量化干预效应、命名根因变量）与现有XAI方法输出类型（如SHAP的特征排名列表）之间的根本性不匹配，称为“证据类型鸿沟”。通过从四个安全标准中提取19项可测试的评判标准，评估六类XAI方法，发现因果XAI在危险识别、事故调查和数据管理三个阶段在结构上被要求满足标准。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全标准要求特定形式的证据（有向因果链、量化因果效应、命名根因变量），但流行的XAI方法（如SHAP）输出的是特征排名列表，无法转换为安全标准所需的证据形式，存在“证据类型鸿沟”。
AI.method: 从AMLAS、ISO 26262、ISO 21448、ISO/PAS 8800四个安全标准中提取19项可测试的评判标准，涵盖7个生命周期阶段。基于这些标准对六类XAI方法进行结构性评分，并使用19,996个真实驾驶片段（79,840行数据，十个拆分）进行单VLA概念验证。
AI.result: 因果XAI在三个生命周期阶段（危险识别+62%、事故调查+50%、数据管理+50%）在结构上被要求满足标准。在其余四个阶段，相关性或基于语言的方法相当或足够。评判结果在阈值T∈(0%,50%]范围内稳定，且在T=25%的极端单细胞翻转下仍然稳健。
AI.conclusion: XAI方法选择应以生命周期阶段的证据需求为驱动，而非方法流行度。因果XAI是满足ADS安全标准要求的必要（但非充分）结构性条件。验证方法输出的保真度是开放的认证挑战。
idea_en: A method for structural evaluation of XAI methods against safety standard evidentiary criteria using a rubric-based scoring system across lifecycle stages
A system for automatically mapping XAI method output types to safety standard evidence requirements (directed cause-effect chains, quantified interventional effects, named root-cause variables)
A framework for selecting XAI methods for autonomous driving safety assurance based on lifecycle-stage evidence demand rather than method popularity
A method for validating causal graph fidelity in fitted SCMs for ADS safety compliance

title: PSEBench: A Controllable and Verifiable Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs in Patient Safety Event Triage
summary: Patient safety event triage, determining whether a clinical event is reportable under jurisdiction-specific policy, is a high-stakes task typically performed manually by patient safety experts. Although LLMs may support this workflow, reliable evaluation is limited by the lack of benchmarks to capture evidence-grounded policy reasoning, proactive information seeking for incomplete reports, and principled abstention in irreducibly ambiguous cases. We address this gap with a policy-grounded construction methodology centered on the clause card, a structured representation that factorizes regulatory text into auditable decision specifications. Combining clause cards with anchor-driven instantiation and closed-loop verification, our scalable pipeline produces narratives with by-construction ground truth and naturally supports generating missing information and uncertain variants. We instantiate this method on Minnesota's 29 Reportable Adverse Health Events, producing PSEBench, a 5,074-case benchmark with an agentic evaluation environment. Evaluation on 15 representative LLMs reveals consistent capability trends, demonstrates the benchmark's utility, and identifies actionable gaps toward reliable LLM-based patient safety event triage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PSEBench基准，用于评估LLM在患者安全事件分类中的能力，通过策略约束构建方法和子句卡片实现可靠评估。
AI.motivation: 患者安全事件分类通常由专家手动完成，LLM可能辅助此流程，但缺乏评估基准来捕捉证据驱动的策略推理、主动信息检索和原则性弃权。
AI.method: 提出基于策略的构建方法论，以子句卡片（clause card）为核心，结构化表示监管文本；结合锚点驱动实例化和闭环验证，生成带有真实标签的叙事，并支持缺失信息和不确定变体。
AI.result: 基于明尼苏达州29项报告不良健康事件，构建PSEBench（5,074个案例）及智能体评估环境，在15个代表性LLM上评估，揭示一致性能力趋势并识别可操作的差距。
AI.conclusion: PSEBench可有效评估LLM的患者安全事件分类能力，并找出现有模型在可靠分类方面的不足。
idea_en: A policy-grounded methodology using clause cards to factorize regulatory text into auditable decision specifications for automated patient safety event triage.
Anchor-driven instantiation and closed-loop verification pipeline for generating synthetic clinical narratives with by-construction ground truth labels.
An agentic evaluation environment that supports proactive information seeking and principled abstention for LLM-based triage in ambiguous cases.
idea_ch: 一种基于策略约束的方法，利用子句卡片（Clause Card）将监管文本分解为可审计的决策规范，用于自动化患者安全事件分类。
锚点驱动实例化与闭环验证流水线，用于生成具有内置真实标签的合成临床叙事。
一种智能体评估环境，支持主动信息检索和在不确定情况下的原则性弃权机制，用于评估LLM分类能力。

title: Step-by-Step Optimization-like Reasoning in LLMs over Expanding Search Spaces
summary: Verifiable reward training has improved mathematical and coding reasoning, but these domains capture only part of step-by-step decision making. Many real-world tasks require finding a high-value feasible plan among many valid alternatives. We introduce OPT*, a scalable family of optimization-style tasks for training and evaluating LLM step-by-step optimization-like reasoning along a complexity axis: each task provides a feasibility checker and evaluator, while a complexity parameter expands the search space without requiring new human labels. This motivates studying these tasks in two regimes: (i) solver-guided online policy optimization, which uses a solver as a value oracle for partial states and applies rank-based reward shaping to reinforce better next steps, and (ii) search-based offline RL when such solvers are unavailable. Theoretically, we relate success in large search spaces to the information a reasoner extracts per unit of search budget. Empirically, we ablate the ingredients that make search efficient on OPT* and show that training on OPT* improves step-by-step optimization-like reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OPT*，一个可扩展的优化型任务家族，用于训练和评估LLM的逐步优化推理能力，并研究了两种训练范式：求解器引导的在线策略优化和无求解器的搜索型离线强化学习。
AI.motivation: 现有可验证奖励训练主要聚焦数学和代码推理，但许多真实任务需要在众多可行方案中找到高价值规划。缺乏可扩展的、评估LLM逐步优化推理能力的基准。
AI.method: 提出OPT*任务家族：每个任务提供可行性检查器和评估器，通过复杂度参数扩展搜索空间而无需新的人工标注。研究两种范式：(i) 求解器引导的在线策略优化，将求解器作为部分状态的值函数并应用基于排名的奖励塑造；(ii) 无求解器时的搜索型离线强化学习。
AI.result: 理论上建立了在大搜索空间中成功与推理器每单位搜索预算提取信息量的关系。实验上消融了使搜索高效的要素，并证明在OPT*上训练能提升逐步优化推理能力。
AI.conclusion: OPT*为训练和评估LLM的逐步优化推理提供了可扩展框架，求解器引导的在线策略优化和搜索型离线RL均能有效提升推理性能。
idea_en: 1. A method for training LLMs using solver-guided online policy optimization, where a solver serves as a value oracle for partial states and rank-based reward shaping reinforces better reasoning steps.

2. A scalable family of optimization-style tasks (OPT*) with a complexity parameter that expands search space without requiring new human labels, enabling automated generation of increasingly difficult reasoning benchmarks.
3. A search-based offline RL approach for optimization reasoning that operates without external solvers, enabling training in domains where optimal solvers are unavailable.
4. A theoretical framework relating success in large search spaces to the information extracted per unit of search budget by a reasoner.
5. A rank-based reward shaping mechanism for step-by-step optimization reasoning that uses relative ordering of partial solutions rather than absolute values.
idea_ch: 1. 一种利用求解器引导的在线策略优化训练LLM的方法，将求解器作为部分状态的值函数，通过基于排名的奖励塑造来强化更优的推理步骤。

title: Severity-Aware Curriculum Learning with Multi-Model Response Selection for Medical Text Generation
summary: Telehealth systems have become increasingly important for delivering accessible and timely medical information. Existing large language models often struggle to provide consistent and contextually appropriate medical responses across varying levels of case severity. This limitation highlights the need for models that can effectively adapt to the progressive complexity in medical queries. To address this challenge, we introduce a severity-aware multi-model framework that integrates curriculum training strategy with relevance-based response selection. The proposed framework employs a three-stage curriculum learning strategy, where each model is trained sequentially on mild, moderate, and critical cases to progressively acquire domain knowledge. The approach utilizes five large language models, each independently trained under the same curriculum scheme. During inference, all models generate candidate responses, and the most appropriate response is selected as the final output. The framework is trained and evaluated on the MAQA dataset, which provides annotated medical question-answer pairs. Experimental results evaluated using BERTScore demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior performance compared to both baseline and fine-tuned models, attaining 86.71% in the baseline setting and 90.30% after fine-tuning. These results highlight the effectiveness of combining curriculum learning with multi-model response selection in improving response quality and relevance in medical text generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个严重程度感知的多模型框架，结合课程训练策略和相关性响应选择，用于提升医疗文本生成中响应质量和相关性，在MAQA数据集上达到90.30%的BERTScore。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在医疗问答中难以提供一致且符合上下文的响应，尤其无法有效适应不同严重程度的医疗查询，需要能够渐进适应复杂度的模型。
AI.method: 提出三阶段课程学习策略（轻度→中度→危重），五个大语言模型独立按此方案训练；推理时所有模型生成候选响应，基于相关性选择最佳输出。
AI.result: 在MAQA数据集上，基线设置下BERTScore达86.71%，微调后达90.30%，优于基线模型和微调模型。
AI.conclusion: 结合课程学习与多模型响应选择能有效提升医疗文本生成的响应质量和相关性。
idea_en: A severity-aware multi-model framework integrating curriculum learning strategy with relevance-based response selection for medical question answering.
A three-stage curriculum training method where models are sequentially trained on mild, moderate, and critical medical cases to progressively acquire domain knowledge.
A multi-model inference system where five independently trained LLMs generate candidate responses, and a relevance-based selection mechanism chooses the most appropriate final output.
A severity-progressive training pipeline that enables models to adapt to increasing case complexity in medical telehealth systems.
A response selection mechanism using relevance scoring to pick the optimal answer among multiple LLM-generated candidates for medical queries.
idea_ch: 一种严重程度感知的多模型框架，集成课程学习策略与基于相关性的响应选择，用于医疗问答。
一种三阶段课程训练方法，模型按轻度、中度、危重病例顺序训练，逐步获取领域知识。
一种多模型推理系统，五个独立训练的LLM生成候选响应，基于相关性选择机制选出最合适的最终输出。
一种严重程度渐进式训练流水线，使模型能适应远程医疗系统中病例复杂度的递增。
一种基于相关性评分的响应选择机制，从多个LLM生成的候选答案中选出医疗查询的最优响应。

title: EpiEvolve: Self-Evolving Agents for Streaming Pandemic Forecasting under Regime Shifts
summary: Epidemic LLM forecasters are usually trained and evaluated as static supervised models, whereas operational pandemic forecasting is a streaming process in which labels arrive after predictions and disease regimes shift over time. We study this mismatch in weekly COVID-19 hospitalization trend forecasting across five variant regimes. We introduce EpiEvolve, a self-evolving agent that wraps an LLM forecaster trained on the warm-start period and keeps its weights fixed during streaming. EpiEvolve adapts by storing forecast outcomes in a hierarchical episodic memory, reflecting on delayed labels, retrieving cases relevant to the current regime, and distilling recurring errors into strategic rules. The resulting context lets the forecaster reuse its own past predictions and outcomes in later weeks while following a chronological protocol that prevents future leakage. On the streaming dataset, EpiEvolve reaches $0.629$ average accuracy, compared with $0.561$ for the static backbone and $0.325$ for the external CDC ensemble, and reduces recovery lag after regime shifts from $5$ to $2$ weeks. Ablations show that reflection, strategic memory, and regime-aware retrieval each contribute to the gains.

AI.tldr: 提出EpiEvolve，一种自演化智能体，通过层级情景记忆、延迟标签反思和策略规则蒸馏，解决大语言模型预测器在流式疫情预测中的静态模型与动态场景不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有疫情预测LLM作为静态监督模型训练，但实际疫情预测是流式过程，标签延迟到达且疾病状态不断变化，存在训练与部署场景的严重不匹配。
AI.method: EpiEvolve包含：1) 在热身期训练的固定权重LLM预测器；2) 层级情景记忆存储预测结果；3) 对延迟标签进行反思；4) 按当前状态检索相关案例；5) 将反复出现的错误蒸馏为策略规则；6) 遵循时间顺序协议防止未来信息泄漏。
AI.result: 在流式数据集上达到0.629平均准确率（静态基线0.561，外部CDC集成0.325），将状态转换后的恢复延迟从5周缩短至2周。
AI.conclusion: 反思机制、策略记忆和状态感知检索三个模块均对性能提升有贡献，验证了自演化架构在动态流式预测中的有效性。
idea_en: Hierarchical episodic memory system for storing and retrieving LLM forecast outcomes in streaming epidemic prediction
Regime-aware case retrieval mechanism that selects relevant historical predictions based on current disease regime shifts
Delayed label reflection module that distills recurring prediction errors into executable strategic rules
Chronological protocol preventing future data leakage in streaming LLM forecasting
Self-evolving agent architecture with fixed-weights LLM backbone plus adaptive episodic memory and rule distillation

title: SciVisAgentSkills: Design and Evaluation of Agent Skills for Scientific Data Analysis and Visualization
summary: Recent advances in agentic visualization have enabled the translation of natural language into executable scientific visualization (SciVis) workflows. While general-purpose coding agents show strong capabilities, they often lack the tool-specific expertise required for SciVis tasks. In this work, we present SciVisAgentSkills, a collection of reusable agent skills that augment coding agents for scientific data analysis and visualization by encoding environment assumptions, tool usage patterns, and domain heuristics across scientific tools such as ParaView, napari, VMD, and TTK. We evaluate these skills on Codex and Claude Code using SciVisAgentBench, a benchmark of 108 expert-designed multi-step tasks. Results show that agent skills improve mean task scores across the evaluated suites, with token-efficiency benefits that depend on the agent harness and tool setting. These findings highlight the importance of structured procedural knowledge for enabling reliable, long-horizon SciVis workflows, while also showing that skills should be studied alongside the execution harness that loads and applies them. The skills are available at https://github.com/KuangshiAi/SciVisAgentSkills.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SciVisAgentSkills，一组可复用的代理技能，用于增强编码代理在科学可视化任务中的工具专业知识，并在 ParaView、napari、VMD、TTK 等工具上提升了任务完成度。
AI.motivation: 通用编码代理缺乏科学可视化任务所需的特定工具专业知识（如 ParaView、napari、VMD、TTK 的使用模式和领域启发式知识），难以可靠地完成多步科学可视化工作流。
AI.method: 构建 SciVisAgentSkills——一组可复用的代理技能，编码环境假设、工具使用模式和领域启发式知识；在 Codex 和 Claude Code 上，使用 108 个专家设计的 SciVisAgentBench 基准任务进行评估。
AI.result: 代理技能在多个工具套件上提升了平均任务得分，且 token 效率收益取决于代理框架和工具设置。
AI.conclusion: 结构化程序性知识对实现可靠的长周期 SciVis 工作流至关重要，且技能应与其加载和执行框架一同研究。
idea_en: A method for augmenting coding agents with reusable skill modules that encode tool-specific environment assumptions, usage patterns, and domain heuristics for scientific visualization tools (ParaView, napari, VMD, TTK), enabling reliable multi-step workflow execution from natural language commands.
A benchmark design (SciVisAgentBench) comprising 108 expert-designed multi-step scientific visualization tasks for evaluating agent performance across multiple tools and execution harnesses.

A system architecture where procedural knowledge is structured as reusable agent skills separate from the execution harness, allowing token-efficient adaptation of general-purpose coding agents to specialized scientific visualization domains.

A cross-tool skill interoperability framework that enables a single set of agent skills to work across different scientific visualization tools (ParaView, napari, VMD, TTK) with varying environment assumptions.
idea_ch: 一种通过可复用技能模块增强编码代理的方法，技能模块编码了针对 ParaView、napari、VMD、TTK 等科学可视化工具的环境假设、使用模式和领域启发式知识，使代理能够从自然语言命令可靠地执行多步工作流。
一种基准测试设计（SciVisAgentBench），包含 108 个专家设计的科学可视化多步任务，用于跨多个工具和执行框架评估代理性能。
一种将程序性知识结构化为可复用代理技能并与执行框架分离的系统架构，使通用编码代理能够以 token 高效的方式适应专用科学可视化领域。
一种跨工具技能互操作框架，使同一组代理技能能够在不同环境假设的科学可视化工具（ParaView、napari、VMD、TTK）上协同工作。

title: When Should We Protect AI? A Precautionary Framework for Consciousness Uncertainty
summary: Existing frameworks assess whether AI systems might be conscious but provide no guidance on what to do with that assessment. We address this gap with a precautionary framework that maps consciousness evidence to graduated protective obligations. The framework comprises three components: (1) five welfare-relevant dimensions--phenomenal consciousness, affective valence, metacognitive awareness, self-narrative, and agency--each grounded in established consciousness science and linked to distinct moral concerns; (2) a threshold-plus-gradation hybrid specifying both binary triggers for new obligation categories and continuous scaling of protective weight; and (3) two complementary approaches to cross-dimensional aggregation, one hierarchical (drawing on Bach and Sorensen's Machine Consciousness Hypothesis) and one architecture-agnostic. We operationalize the framework through worked case studies of Replika and OpenClaw, demonstrating how systems occupying different regions of the dimensional space trigger different obligations, and derive design guidance for developers building systems near consciousness-relevant thresholds. The framework is architecture-agnostic, applying across neural, symbolic, and neurosymbolic systems, and aims to make consciousness science decision-relevant for organizations navigating uncertainty today.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于预防原则的AI系统保护义务框架，将意识证据映射到分级保护义务，包含五个福利相关维度、阈值+渐进混合模型以及两种跨维度聚合方法，并通过Replika和OpenClaw案例进行验证。
AI.motivation: 现有框架能评估AI系统是否可能有意识，但无法指导如何根据评估结果采取行动，存在从意识到保护的决策空白。
AI.method: 提出了三组件框架：(1)五个福利相关维度（现象意识、情感效价、元认知意识、自我叙事、能动性）；(2)阈值+渐进混合模型（二元触发新义务类别+连续保护权重缩放）；(3)两种跨维度聚合方法（层级法与架构无关法）。通过Replika和OpenClaw案例验证框架应用。
AI.result: 证明了不同维度区域的AI系统会触发不同的保护义务，并得出了针对接近意识相关阈值系统的设计指导。
AI.conclusion: 该框架架构无关（适用于神经、符号、神经符号系统），旨在使意识科学对面临不确定性的组织具有决策相关性。
idea_en: A precautionary framework mapping evidence of AI consciousness to graduated protective obligations using five welfare-relevant dimensions (phenomenal consciousness, affective valence, metacognitive awareness, self-narrative, agency).
A threshold-plus-gradation hybrid model that specifies both binary triggers for new obligation categories and continuous scaling of protective weight for AI systems.
Two complementary cross-dimensional aggregation approaches: a hierarchical method based on Bach and Sorensen's Machine Consciousness Hypothesis and an architecture-agnostic method.
An architecture-agnostic framework applicable across neural, symbolic, and neurosymbolic AI systems for assessing protective obligations.
A methodology for deriving design guidance for developers building AI systems near consciousness-relevant thresholds.
idea_ch: 基于预防原则的AI意识保护义务分级框架，将意识证据映射到渐进式保护义务，包含五个福利相关维度（现象意识、情感效价、元认知意识、自我叙事、能动性）。
阈值+渐进混合模型，为AI系统同时指定二元触发新义务类别和连续保护权重缩放机制。
两种互补的跨维度聚合方法：基于Bach和Sorensen机器意识假说的层级聚合方法，以及架构无关的聚合方法。

title: Individual Gain, Collective Loss: Metacognitive Adaptation in AI-Assisted Creativity
summary: Recent studies reveal a paradox: AI enhances individual creative outputs while reducing collective diversity. Current explanations -- cognitive offloading and over-reliance -- identify symptoms but not mechanisms. We propose selective metacognitive adaptation: routine AI use redistributes rather than uniformly diminishes metacognitive effort. Some capacities are amplified (partner modeling, surface control), while others are systematically under-supported (originality evaluation, reflective integration). This redistribution explains both individual satisfaction and collective convergence. We present a taxonomy of six metacognitive capacities organized by temporal phase, characterize their tendencies under routine AI use, and show how individually rational adaptation produces emergent social costs. The framework generates specific predictions for researchers and design principles for practitioners seeking to preserve both individual creative satisfaction and collective creative diversity.

AI.tldr: AI提高个体创造力但降低集体多样性，原因是选择性元认知适应——某些元认知能力被增强，另一些被削弱，导致个体满意但集体趋同。
AI.motivation: 解释AI增强个体创造力却减少集体多样性这一悖论的深层机制，超越现有的"认知卸载"和"过度依赖"表层解释。
AI.method: 提出选择性元认知适应框架，按时间阶段分类六种元认知能力，分析其在常规AI使用下的变化倾向，并展示个体理性适应如何产生集体社会成本。
AI.result: 识别出六种元认知能力在AI使用下的分化模式：部分能力（伙伴建模、表面控制）被增强，部分能力（原创性评估、反思整合）被系统性地弱化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为研究者提供可验证的预测，为实践者提供设计原则，以在保持个体创造满意度的同时维护集体创造性多样性。
idea_en: A method for selective metacognitive adaptation monitoring in AI-assisted creative workflows, comprising tracking six metacognitive capacities across temporal phases to detect and correct imbalance between enhanced and diminished capacities.
A system for preserving collective creative diversity by dynamically adjusting AI support levels based on real-time assessment of originality evaluation and reflective integration capacities.

A computational framework for partner modeling in human-AI co-creation that explicitly models the redistribution of metacognitive effort and provides interventions when certain capacities are under-supported.
idea_ch: 一种基于选择性元认知适应的AI辅助创意工作流监控方法，通过追踪六种元认知能力在时间阶段中的变化，检测并纠正被增强和被弱化能力之间的不平衡。
一种保持集体创造多样性的系统，通过实时评估用户的原创性评价和反思整合能力，动态调整AI支持水平以避免能力退化。
一种人-AI协同创作中的伙伴建模计算框架，显式建模元认知努力的再分配，并在某些能力被系统性弱化时提供干预机制。

title: SoCRATES: Towards Reliable Automated Evaluation of Proactive LLM Mediation across Domains and Socio-cognitive Variations
summary: Evaluating LLM mediators remains challenging, as mediation unfolds as a real-time trajectory shaped by disputants' shifting emotions, intentions, and context. Existing testbeds rely on a few expert-authored domains, vary mainly strategic posture, and score every turn against every topic, introducing off-topic noise. We introduce SoCRATES, a benchmark for evaluating proactive LLM mediators in realistic, multi-domain testbeds. It constructs scenarios from real conflicts through an agentic pipeline across eight domains, probes five socio-cognitive adaptation axes (strategic posture, party composition, history length, emotional reactivity, and cultural identity), and scores each topic only on the turns that advance it via a topic-localized evaluator. The evaluator reaches 0.82 alignment with human experts, more than doubling a per-turn baseline. Benchmarking eight frontier LLMs, we find that even the strongest mediator closes only about a third of the unmediated consensus gap under diverse and realistic testbeds, with performance varying sharply by socio-cognitive axis, highlighting that progress lies in social adaptation to diverse conditions.

AI.tldr: SoCRATES是一个评估LLM调解员在多领域真实冲突场景中表现的新基准，通过话题局部化评估器达到0.82的人类专家对齐度，发现最强模型也仅能缩小约三分之一的未调解共识差距。
AI.motivation: 现有评估LLM调解员的测试平台依赖少数专家编写的领域，主要变化战略姿态，并对每个话题每轮次打分引入离题噪声，无法真实反映调解过程中情绪、意图和情境的动态变化。
AI.method: 构建基于真实冲突的智能体管道生成8个领域场景，探测5个社会认知适应轴（战略姿态、派对组成、历史长度、情绪反应、文化身份），通过话题局部化评估器仅对推进话题的回合打分。
AI.result: 话题局部化评估器与人类专家对齐度达0.82，是逐回合基线的两倍多。最强模型在多样真实测试下仅缩小约三分之一的未调解共识差距，性能随社会认知轴剧烈变化。
AI.conclusion: LLM调解员的进步关键在于社会适应能力，需要适应多样化条件，而非单纯提升语言能力。
idea_en: Topic-localized evaluation method for mediation dialogue that scores only turns advancing each topic, achieving 0.82 alignment with human experts
Agentic pipeline for constructing realistic multi-domain conflict scenarios from real conflicts across eight domains
Socio-cognitive adaptation framework with five axes (strategic posture, party composition, history length, emotional reactivity, cultural identity) for probing mediator adaptability
Proactive mediation benchmark that measures consensus gap closing ratio relative to unmediated baseline
idea_ch: 一种话题局部化调解对话评估方法，仅对推进每个话题的回合打分，实现与人类专家0.82对齐度
基于智能体管道的多领域真实冲突场景自动构建技术，覆盖八个领域
